QUOTE: `library/memory_buffer_alloc.c` provides a heap over a caller-supplied static buffer. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` (`:566-576`) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` itself
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the buffer allocator calling the runtime setter from its init function. It doesn't say "only in-tree user", but it does say the allocator installs itself, which covers the core mechanism.
